CHAPTER.VERS: I will lift up my eyes to the mountains.O whence shall help for me come?
From the comes help to methe creator of heaven and earth.
Your foot he will not let totter:he who guards you will not sleep.
The guardian of Israelwill neither slumber nor sleep.
The is he who guards youyour shelter upon your right hand.
The sun by day shall not strike you,nor the moon by night.
From all evil the will guard you,he will guard your life.
The will guard your going and comingfrom now and for evermore.
